pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 12...Bd7 13.Nf1
pages.notes: Plan 2 sent the a5-knight to b7/c6 squares the parser could not read and offered a ...d5 break; plan 3 put a rook on c1 with the bishop still there; plan 4 called a closed c-file semi-open. Rewrote plans 2-4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 12...Nc6 13.d5
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave an f2-f4 attack, not this line's plan; plan 3 spoke of central tension in a closed centre; plan 4 sent the d8-knight to f8 and b7 with a bare ...Nf8 it cannot make. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4 around Nf1-g3, a4 and ...Nd8 with ...Ne8, ...f6, ...Nf7. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 12...Nc6 13.d5 Na5
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 centred White's play on an f2-f4 push and sent 'the b1 knight' via f1 (it is on d2); plan 2 prepared for that f4 push. Rewrote the overview and both plans around b3, Nf1-g3 and ...Nb7, ...c4, ...b4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, Rauzer Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Nbd2-f1-g3 (or e3) with the knight already on d2. Rewrote it around Nf1-e3 and the open d-file. British spelling.

pages.name: Rauzer Variation, Ruy Lopez
pages.notes: Plan 1 manoeuvred a knight from f1 that is on d2; plan 2 offered a ...d5 break with no black d-pawn left. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Chigorin Defense, Panov System
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Nbd2-f1-g3(e3) with the knight already on d2. Rewrote it as Nf1-g3 with Nf5 ideas. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 13...Bb7 14.Nf1
pages.notes: Plan 1 built White's attack on f2-f4; plan 4 sent the a5-knight to b7, where the bishop stands, and offered a ...d5 break. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 13...Bb7 14.Nf1 Rac8 15.Re2
pages.notes: Plan 4 had the e2-rook swing to g2 through White's own f2-pawn and to c2 where the bishop stands. Rewrote it. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 13...Nc6 14.Nb3 a5 15.Be3 a4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a knight go Nb3-d2 and also Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 2 sent the c6-knight to e7, where the bishop stands; plan 4 offered a ...d5 break. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 13...Nc6 14.Nf1
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Bd7 pressure d4; plan 3 used a b3-knight that is not there and an Re1-e3-g3 lift. Rewrote both (first plan 3 rewrite rejected because a knight on e3 does not cover d4; corrected and accepted). British spelling.
